capabilities: Previews AI continuations as grey text in the Markdown editor
Accepts full or partial suggestions via Tab, Esc and commands
Sends cursor-adjacent context to an OpenAI-compatible provider
Filters and validates model output for repetition and truncation
Tracks local usage, latency and acceptance statistics
extras: Beta (0.1.3); API keys stored in plain text in data.json; statistics reset on reload; generation is non-streaming; mobile and non-desktop behavior not verified; no path exclusion list, so note content is sent to the configured provider.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no built-in AI autocompletion, so writers must leave the app or paste context into external tools to get continuations.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible model server (base URL and model ID)

summary: Inline AI completion plugin that previews Markdown continuations as grey text in the editor, with partial acceptance and local usage statistics.
